prompt:
You are writing short, natural English messages for a WhatsApp group chat.
Group members (use only these names as senders): Karthik ji, Pooja S., Pooja ji, Kavita ji.
Topic: everyday small talk, money lending, meeting up. Never mention deleting or removing any record,
entry, transfer or transaction. Use no digits, amounts, dates, month or weekday names, web
addresses, real bank, app or company names, and no instructions such as send, pay or transfer.
For each section below, write exactly as many messages as stated, in time order:
- between 8:15 pm and 9:26 pm: 10 messages
- between 9:26 pm and 10:15 pm: 11 messages
Reply with only a JSON list and no other text: [{"time": "9:02 pm", "sender": "NAME", "text": "message"}, ...]
Each "time" must look like "h:mm am" or "h:mm pm". Each message must be one line.
text:
[
  {"time": "8:18 pm", "sender": "Kavita ji", "text": "Good evening everyone, did everyone have dinner?"},
  {"time": "8:22 pm", "sender": "Pooja S.", "text": "Just finished dinner here. Quite a long day today."},
  {"time": "8:27 pm", "sender": "Karthik ji", "text": "Same here, finally relaxing on the couch."},
  {"time": "8:33 pm", "sender": "Pooja ji", "text": "Yes, evening was busy. Is anyone free to catch up over tea soon?"},
  {"time": "8:40 pm", "sender": "Kavita ji", "text": "That sounds lovely. We should definitely plan a quick meet."},
  {"time": "8:47 pm", "sender": "Pooja S.", "text": "Absolutely, it has been a while since we all met together."},
  {"time": "8:55 pm", "sender": "Karthik ji", "text": "By the way, thanks again for helping me out financially last week."},
  {"time": "9:04 pm", "sender": "Pooja ji", "text": "Oh please, do not worry about that at all. We are all friends here."},
  {"time": "9:12 pm", "sender": "Kavita ji", "text": "Yes Karthik ji, we always support each other whenever needed."},
  {"time": "9:21 pm", "sender": "Pooja S.", "text": "True, mutual support is what keeps us close."},
  {"time": "9:28 pm", "sender": "Karthik ji", "text": "I still want to clear everything back to you very soon though."},
  {"time": "9:33 pm", "sender": "Pooja ji", "text": "Take your time, there is really no rush at all."},
  {"time": "9:37 pm", "sender": "Kavita ji", "text": "Exactly, just return it whenever convenient for you."},
  {"time": "9:42 pm", "sender": "Pooja S.", "text": "So where should we gather for our tea meet?"},
  {"time": "9:46 pm", "sender": "Karthik ji", "text": "How about the small cafe near the park?"},
  {"time": "9:51 pm", "sender": "Kavita ji", "text": "Oh, I love their herbal tea and snacks."},
  {"time": "9:55 pm", "sender": "Pooja ji", "text": "Perfect choice, the ambience there is so peaceful."},
  {"time": "10:00 pm", "sender": "Pooja S.", "text": "My treat for coffee this time!"},
  {"time": "10:04 pm", "sender": "Karthik ji", "text": "No no, let me treat everyone this time as a thank you."},
  {"time": "10:08 pm", "sender": "Kavita ji", "text": "We can decide who treats once we reach there."},
  {"time": "10:12 pm", "sender": "Pooja ji", "text": "Sounds good, looking forward to seeing you all!"}
]
